<!-- pr-reviewer: f57b3266cc34f94fd650155cd09c62cba92cc0e2 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good
- One helper, `pick_button` / `pick_widget` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/pick_button.rs`), replaces the separate styles at 11 call sites. Behaviour and commands do not change.
- The change stays in `camcraft-ui`. It uses only egui and the theme colours. No world call, no new dependency, no layering problem.
- The new module has a provenance line and is about 54 lines. It adds no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!`.
- No snapshot PNG changed.
- The tests use accesskit toggled state, not pixels. `an_armed_pick_button_reads_as_toggled_on_and_an_idle_one_as_off` checks the armed and idle state.

Results (merged with main, run locally)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib pick` (from `crates/ui`): 114 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 786 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The trial merge with main had no conflict. Not run on the self-hosted runner.

Requested before merge
- None.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
- The new tests are in `pick_button.rs`, not in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs`. They are text-only and structural, so they follow the intent of the law. You can add one structural row for a real page (for example "Pick tip") later.
- The Geometry page Pick rows keep the old style until issue 1726. This is stated in the PR body.
- Before and after screenshots are not in the PR. The maintainer decided to merge without them.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: f57b3266cc34f94fd650155cd09c62cba92cc0e2 -->

Needs changes before merge. The code passes review. One item is missing: the before/after screenshot pair in the body.

**What looks good:**

- `pick_button.rs` is pure presentation. It reads `ui.visuals()` and sets fill and stroke. It has no world calls and no `sys_*` calls. The UI layering law holds.
- All 11 converted call sites keep their old arm condition and their old click handler. Only the widget style changed. The diff shows this at each hunk.
- The two pick buttons in `setup_orient_pick.rs` moved from `ui.button` to the shared style. Their armed condition `mine && collecting(state)` is unchanged.
- The WCS circle row uses `pick_widget` inside `add_sized`. Its size and click behaviour are the same as before.
- The diff adds no state writes. It adds no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic` outside tests.
- The two new tests pin the armed state with AccessKit `toggled`. This meets the structural test part of issue #1728.
- The module carries a provenance line. Every touched file stays under 400 lines. `egui_kittest` is already a dev-dependency; no new dependency.
- Leaving the Geometry page rows to issue #1726 is correct, as the body says.

**Results (built on the self-hosted runner, macOS m3):** https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43657553338

- Head confirmed: f57b3266cc34f94fd650155cd09c62cba92cc0e2. The run trial-merged the PR with main at e2f012e9.
- Quick gate: ui suites ok, 55 s, 0 failed.
- Clippy `-p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Requested before merge:**

1. The body has no before/after screenshot pair. The maintainer's standing rule for UI PRs asks for it, and "Done means" on issue #1728 asks for it. The body itself says the pair is owed. Add two images to the PR body. No code change is needed.

**Notes (not blocking):**

- The two plain buttons in `setup_orient_pick.rs` now report a toggle state to AccessKit. That is an improvement for assistive tech. No structural test asserts on those rows, and the run is green.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
